nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Public decimals value (18) used to scale the initial supply.
Public total token supply; mutated in constructor, burn and burnFrom with unchecked arithmetic.
Public mapping of holder balances; written by constructor, _transfer, burn and burnFrom.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender allowances; written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: mints initialSupply*10**decimals to msg.sender and sets name/symbol.
Internal transfer routine adjusting balanceOf and emitting Transfer; performs unchecked balance addition.
Public transfer that forwards msg.sender as the source into _transfer.
Public delegated transfer that decrements allowance[from][msg.sender] then calls _transfer.
Public approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emitting Approval.
Public approval that then invokes an arbitrary external contract via receiveApproval.
Public burn reducing caller balance and totalSupply with unchecked subtraction.
Public delegated burn reducing balanceOf[_from], allowance and totalSupply with unchecked subtraction.
Caller-controlled address used as holder, spender, owner and as argument to the external callback.
External call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender,_value,this,_extraData) to an attacker-controlled address.
Unchecked multiplication initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) in the constructor.
Unchecked totalSupply -= _value in burn; can underflow/inflate supply.
Unchecked totalSupply -= _value in burnFrom; can underflow/inflate supply.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition in _transfer.
Constructor parameter used to compute the minted totalSupply.
Constructor parameter assigned to state variable name.
Constructor parameter assigned to state variable symbol.
Internal _transfer source address parameter.
Internal _transfer destination address parameter.
Internal _transfer amount parameter.
Public transfer destination address parameter.
Public transfer amount parameter.
transferFrom owner address parameter.
transferFrom destination address parameter.
transferFrom amount parameter.
approve spender address parameter.
approve amount parameter.
approveAndCall spender address parameter (also the external contract target).
approveAndCall amount parameter.
Arbitrary bytes forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
burn amount parameter.
burnFrom owner address parameter.
burnFrom amount parameter.
Local snapshot of balanceOf[_from]+balanceOf[_to] used by the post-transfer assertion.
Local tokenRecipient handle cast from the user-supplied _spender and used for the external call.

edges.reason: Constructor writes totalSupply from the unchecked multiplication result.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor assigns tokenName into the name state variable.
Constructor assigns tokenSymbol into the symbol state variable.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial token holder.
Constructor execution reaches the unchecked supply multiplication.
initialSupply parameter flows into the unchecked multiplication.
Overflowable multiplication result is stored into totalSupply.
initialSupply is consumed by the constructor mint computation.
tokenName is consumed by the constructor.
tokenName value is stored into name.
tokenSymbol is consumed by the constructor.
tokenSymbol value is stored into symbol.
_from parameter is the debit side of the internal transfer.
_to parameter is validated against zero then credited.
_value parameter drives the unchecked balance arithmetic in _transfer.
_transfer reads and mutates balanceOf for both parties.
_transfer executes the unchecked balance addition.
Added balance value is written back into balanceOf.
_transfer snapshots balances into the previousBalances local.
transfer destination parameter flows to the internal call.
transfer amount parameter flows to the internal arithmetic.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument.
transferFrom owner parameter flows into allowance and transfer logic.
transferFrom destination parameter flows into _transfer.
transferFrom amount parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key.
approve spender parameter is the allowance key.
approve value parameter is the allowance amount written.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approveAndCall spender parameter is both allowance key and external call target.
approveAndCall value parameter is forwarded to approve and the callback.
_extraData parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callback.
approveAndCall invokes approve before the external call.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval invocation.
External call sends msg.sender as an argument to attacker-controlled code.
Local spender handle is derived from the user-supplied _spender.
Local spender contract handle is the target of the external call.
approveAndCall indirectly mutates the allowance mapping through approve.
burn amount parameter drives unchecked balance and supply subtraction.
burn reads and decrements balanceOf[msg.sender].
burn decrements the totalSupply state variable.
burn executes the unchecked totalSupply subtraction.
Underflowable subtraction result is stored into totalSupply.
burn operates on the caller identified by msg.sender.
burnFrom owner parameter keys balanceOf and allowance.
burnFrom amount parameter drives unchecked balance/allowance/supply arithmetic.
burnFrom reads and decrements balanceOf[_from].
burnFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
burnFrom decrements the totalSupply state variable.
burnFrom executes the unchecked totalSupply subtraction.
Underflowable subtraction result is stored into totalSupply.
burnFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender key.
